Name: Demetrius. New Look (Seasonal)
Author: pinzol
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5][b]UPDATED FOR 1.6. SEASONAL + FACIAL HAIR AND GLASSES[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4]
Alright, I've tried a few options for Demetrius a few times before and decided to go back to a more vanilla look for him, slightly changed and improved.
[/color]
[size=5][b]What's New:
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#e69138]Seasonal Outfits[/color], coded for 1.6.
[*]Slightly edited [color=#e69138]Lab Room at Robin's [/color](You can turn it off in the settings).
[*]Added optional [color=#e69138]Appearance Settings[/color]:
[/list]﻿ ﻿- Beard,
﻿﻿- Mustache (Harvey's finally got some competition),
﻿- Glasses,
﻿- Winter Hat (The hat is a bit goofy, turn it off if it bothers you).

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/17925/17925-1746193042-1816745387.gif[/img]

-------------------------------------------------
[color=#ffff00]
[b]How to install the mod:[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Have the LATEST version of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher [/url]﻿installed.
[*]Download my mod from here and drop the folder inside into your Mods folder.
[*]Highly recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=description]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] by spacechase0 to change mod's settings more comfortably. Or just change config.json file in the mod's folder manually.
[/list]-------------------------------------------------

[color=#e06666][b]Warning:[/b][/color]
This mod can and will conflict with any other mod that changes Demetrius' appearance. It will also conflict with mods that changes Robin's House map. 

-------------------------------------------------
